name: strikeglass
description: Strikeglass is a responsive local-first Neverwinter combat-log analyzer with double-checked combat results, boss debuff uptime, player comparison, power damage, progressive loading, and raw-hit traceability.
author: Nischhal Raj Subba

scripts.syntax: node --check src/v3/app.js && node --check src/v3/power-drilldown.js && node --check src/v3/charts.js && node --check src/v3/ambient.js && node --check src/v6/dashboard.js && node --check src/v6/dashboard-interactions.js && node --check src/v6/copy.js && node --check src/v6/drawer-copy.js && node --check src/v7/worker-bridge.js && node --check src/v7/boss-effects.js && node --check src/workers/fast-parse-worker.js && node --check src/engine/fast-parser-core.js && node --check src/engine/verification-engine.js && node --check src/engine/power-taxonomy.js && node --check src/engine/boss-effects.js
scripts.test: pnpm syntax && node scripts/smoke-test.mjs && node scripts/v6-regression.mjs && node scripts/copy-regression.mjs && node scripts/performance-regression.mjs && node scripts/parser-regression.mjs && node scripts/entity-ref-regression.mjs && node scripts/verification-regression.mjs && node scripts/scope-regression.mjs && node scripts/boss-effects-regression.mjs
scripts.build: pnpm test && node build-static.mjs && cp src/seo/robots.txt public/robots.txt && cp src/seo/sitemap.txt public/sitemap.txt && cp src/seo/site.webmanifest public/site.webmanifest && cp src/seo/site.css public/site.css && mkdir -p public/how-to-use public/dps-explained public/privacy public/about && cp src/seo/how-to-use/index.html public/how-to-use/index.html && cp src/seo/dps-explained/index.html public/dps-explained/index.html && cp src/seo/privacy/index.html public/privacy/index.html && cp src/seo/about.html public/about/index.html
